aviso: Synthetic test call: AI voices reading a role-play script. The store, Maya, Jordan and Sam are invented for testing.

transcripcion.texto: Hi Maya, thanks for making time. Before I show anything, how do customer questions reach you today?
Mostly email and Instagram DMs. It's me and one part-time person, Jordan. Honestly, half my mornings go to "where is my order?".
Half your mornings. Roughly how many messages a day is that?
Around 40 on a normal day, way more after a launch.
And which questions come up the most?
Shipping times, whether the candles are safe around pets, and returns when a jar arrives cracked.
Got it. If those three got answered automatically, with the hard ones still coming to you, what would that be worth?
If it gave me my mornings back, I could see spending three to five hundred a month. More than that, I'd need to see it working first.
Fair. Who else would be part of the decision?
Just me. My business partner Sam signs off on anything over five hundred.
Before Black Friday, so ideally set up by mid-November.
Okay. Here's what I suggest. I'll send you a short proposal by Friday, and we book 30 minutes next Tuesday to walk through it with Sam.

resumen: Maya handles customer inquiries via email and Instagram DMs with one part-time assistant and spends half her mornings dealing with common questions about shipping, pet safety, and returns. The seller discussed an automated answering solution. Maya expressed interest within a $300-$500/month budget, aiming to have it implemented before Black Friday. The seller agreed to send a proposal by Friday and scheduled a follow-up call with Maya and her business partner Sam for next Tuesday.
